front.intro: The work on this East End bungalow started below the floor, where the foundation was reworked, leveled and braced before anything else went in. The wiring and the breaker box are new, along with the plumbing, and three-phase power is wired to the panel. Hardi Plank siding and a new roof finish the outside, and the driveway and the fence are new too. Inside, the Kitchen and both baths are new, and the wood-look floors continue through the whole house with no thresholds between rooms.

top.kicker: The floor plan and the front rooms
top.title: The complete layout, room by room
top.planNote: Approximate and not to scale. The front door and the Living Room are at the bottom of the plan. The buyer verifies every room size and every label on the plan before relying on them.

left.name: Front Entry
left.text: The front door is stained wood with glass panes across the top, and the Living Room starts right behind it. A large window on the left wall looks out to the front yard. The Kitchen peninsula is visible from the door.

left.name: Breakfast Bar
left.text: Two pendant lights hang over the Kitchen peninsula, with room for barstools along the counter. The marble-look counters and backsplash continue around the L, so the peninsula matches the rest of the Kitchen.

right.name: Dining Area
right.text: The Dining area is the link between the Kitchen peninsula and the hall to the bedrooms. A cased opening on the front side joins it to the Living Room. A round table fits here with space to pull out the chairs.

right.name: Breakfast Nook
right.text: Windows on two walls bring natural light into the Breakfast Nook, and the Kitchen counter wraps one side of the room. A door on the back wall leads out to the rear deck, the fenced yard and the covered patio.

photo.name: Covered Patio and Garage
photo.text: The covered patio and the covered garage stand side by side across the back of the fenced yard. The covered garage measures 14 x 24 feet and has a concrete floor under a solid roof. String lights are already up under the patio roof.

bottom.title: The Primary, the bedrooms and the baths

items.name: Primary Bedroom
items.text: The Primary is at the back of the house, away from the street, with a vaulted ceiling and an exposed painted beam overhead. It is the largest bedroom in the house. The closet and the Primary Bath both open off it.

items.name: Primary Bath
items.text: A dark navy double-sink vanity stands under a wide LED backlit mirror. The glass shower has full-height marble-look tile, a rain showerhead and a handheld. A doorway on the Primary's closet wall opens straight into the bath.

items.name: Hall Bath
items.text: Serving Bedrooms 2 and 3 and guests, this bath has a tub with marble-look tile that goes all the way up the wall. A pebble tile niche is set into the tile wall. An LED mirror hangs over the sink. Both bedrooms are a few steps away.

items.name: Primary Closet
items.text: A built-in shelving tower stands in the middle, with hanging rods along both sides. Shelves above the rods hold bins or luggage. The built-ins stay with the house. Both doors swing open to show the whole closet at once.

items.name: Bedroom 2
items.text: Windows on two walls light the larger of the two secondary bedrooms, which is at the front corner of the house. It and Bedroom 3 share the hall bath. The Primary is across the house, so the two rooms stay well apart.

items.name: Bedroom 3
items.text: The closet is on the hall side, which leaves the window wall open for a desk. The carpet is new. It is between Bedroom 2 and the Primary, on the same hall. A wide window on the side wall lights the room through the day.

back.title: Living Room and Kitchen, with the Dining area between

items.name: Living Room
items.text: A wide cased opening joins the Living Room to the Dining area and the Kitchen, so the whole front of the house reads as one space. A clerestory window high on the wall brings in natural light and keeps the room private from the street. Wood-look floors carry through without a threshold, from the front door to the Kitchen.

items.name: Kitchen
items.text: The Kitchen is all new, laid out in an L with a peninsula that faces the Dining area. A stainless range stands under a chimney hood, with the sink under the window and a stainless dishwasher beside it. A pair of pendants hangs over the peninsula, which has room for barstools. Wood-look floors continue from the Dining area.
